title: Gangster finale: the President fight plays the generic 'boss' song, not boss_gang (the gang theme played heavy, made for exactly this fight)
repro: Gang arc ch5, uptown, beat g5_president. effects = {music:'boss', boss_card:'president'}. story.gd applies boss_card (line ~401: boss_card -> boss_track('president') = boss_gang, DangerMusic.boss_started(boss_gang)) and THEN fx.music (line ~407) plays 'boss'. DangerMusic does not take it back because 'boss' is in GameMap.BOSS_TRACKS and tier==4 (danger_music.gd ~147). Same bug in the penguin finale p5_spire (dark_crystal -> boss_penguin overwritten by 'boss').
fix: In story.gd skip fx.music when fx also has boss_card (or apply music before boss_card); or drop "music": "boss" from g5_president and p5_spire in story data (edit whatever writes story.json if generated).

title: Gangster Orchard Hills campaign captain is Big Grump and plays boss_penguin (the penguin theme) in the gang arc
repro: battles.json c_orchard_hills n3 (boss) and n4 (gate): node.boss = 'big_grump', only cfg.penguins has a boss (gcap_orchard_hills); cfg.gangsters has none, so Campaign.boss_of falls back to big_grump in the gang arc. GameMap.boss_track('big_grump') -> 'boss_penguin' regardless of arc (k in [big_grump, dark_crystal, grump_commander, finargle] has no is_penguins() guard). Gang player hears the dark penguin theme (and fights a penguin-world boss).
fix: gen_battles.py: give every shared ('both') campaign node a cfg.gangsters.boss (thug lieutenant/enforcer variants, via gang_kind or a GANG_CAPTAINS table) so gang runs never field big_grump. In boss_track, guard the boss_penguin branch with GameState.is_penguins() and send gang-arc bosses to boss_gang.

title: Gang captains in docks/underground and the shared campaigns get the generic 'boss' (or mine 'keeper') song instead of boss_gang
repro: boss_track: c_docks captain rust_knight -> 'boss'; c_underground drip_crawler -> 'boss'; shared campaigns in the gang arc: hill_wolf/bog_hag/river_serpent/ruin_guardian -> 'boss', quarry_golem -> 'keeper' (contains 'golem'; the mine keepers' stone drums). Only thug_* captains (countryside, neon, uptown) get boss_gang.
fix: In boss_track, when Racket.on() and the foe is a campaign captain (Battle sets a meta, or scene_id().begins_with('bf_')), return boss_gang unless a MEGA theme applies; keep 'keeper' for the mine only (scene_id()=='mine'). Or give gang cfgs thug captains in gen_battles.py.

title: After the President falls (g5_win, uptown) the story plays the playful 'meadow' song in Uptown
repro: g5_win effects.music = 'meadow' (also p5_win). Story plays it on the uptown map; DangerMusic re-asks area_track within AREA_EVERY (3 s) after boss grace, so you get a jarring glockenspiel blip / crossfade in the noir city at the arc's emotional climax.
fix: Replace music:'meadow' with 'arc_gangsters' (the gang theme; penguin win: 'arc_penguins'), or have story.gd treat music:'area' as m.area_track(). If a held song is wanted, DangerMusic needs a short 'story hold' so it isn't replaced in 3 s.

title: The Outskirts (gang arc crystal_meadow, gangster turf) has no song of its own: it plays the generic wistful 'rain' piece every day, night, season and weather
repro: ARC=gangsters, walk farm -> meadow -> outskirts (crystal_meadow). crystal_meadow.gd:27 music_track = 'cattopia' if penguins else 'rain'; crystal_meadow is not in NIGHT_OK or AREA_MUSIC, so area_track() returns 'rain' (felt piano, 'rainy days') on a sunny morning too. Probe (tools/probe_c6_02_gangmusic.gd): crystal_meadow day=rain night=rain. The penguin counterpart has its own song (cattopia). It is also the same track as every rainy day on the farm/town, so it never reads as a place.
fix: Add an 'outskirts' track (gang turf: lo-fi street funk / noir bass, 92 bpm) and set crystal_meadow.gd music_track = 'outskirts' for the gang arc (fallback 'hideout' until rendered: Music.has_track check, like region music_fallback). Add it to music_map_test's situation list.
audio_needed: New ACE track 'outskirts': gangster-arc turf at the edge of the valley, gritty lo-fi funk, muted guitar, upright bass, vinyl crackle, light street percussion, 92 bpm, loopable.

title: Gang arc home maps after dark play the cosy penguin-style 'night' piece (celesta, harp): no noir night variant for the gang arc
repro: ARC=gangsters, any NIGHT_OK map (farm, town, meadow, lake, beach, mountain, forest, orchard_hills, countryside, riverlands, highlands) after sunset -> 'night' (slow celesta, warm pads, soft harp, 60 bpm). Probe: all 11 return 'night'. The gang arc's opening is pitched as a rainy noir night, and its city areas (neon, docks, hideout) are jazz/noir; at night the valley drops back to a lullaby.
fix: In area_track: if not GameState.is_penguins() and Music.has_track('night_gang') return 'night_gang' instead of 'night' (same pattern as battle_gang). Optionally also 'rain_gang'.
audio_needed: New ACE track 'night_gang': late-night noir jazz, soft brushed drums, muted trumpet, Rhodes, 66 bpm, quiet and loopable (outdoors after dark, gangster arc).
needs_tom: Do you want the gang arc's valley at night to sound noir (night_gang), or keep one shared night song for both stories?

title: Gang escort/supply battles play the penguin-feel 'battle_escort' (hopeful light strings): there is no battle_escort_gang
repro: area_track on bf_* with battle.mode in [escort, supply] -> 'battle_escort'; the '_gang' suffix only applies when the file exists (battle_gang, battle_siege_gang exist; battle_escort_gang does not). Shared ('both') campaigns field an escort node, so the gang arc reaches it. Also campaign_screen.gd:58 plays the shared 'campaign_map' on the gang 'war table' board.
fix: No code change needed beyond rendering: area_track already picks battle_escort_gang once the file exists. For the board: campaign_screen.gd play('campaign_map_gang' if not penguins and has_track else 'campaign_map').
audio_needed: battle_escort_gang: steady funk march, bass and horns, moving-convoy feel, 112 bpm. Optional campaign_map_gang: noir map-room, ticking percussion, plucked bass, 90 bpm.

title: Heists play no music cue at all (dialogue only at the hideout lounge song)
repro: Ops._run_heist (ops.gd ~121) runs the whole job as dialogue with only sfx('quest_done'); the hideout lo-fi keeps playing through planning, the job and success/failure.
fix: Play 'raid' (exists: fast synth bass, snare rolls) when the job starts and return to m.area_track() after; j_victory / a fail sting at the end. DangerMusic re-asks area_track every 3 s when calm, so hold it (e.g. a DangerMusic story-hold flag or Hud pause owner) during the heist dialogue.

title: Mega areas reuse gangster-city songs in both arcs, and regions.json keeps penguin/boss placeholders as gang-region music_track
repro: gilt_casino_row -> 'neon', iron_mill_district -> 'hideout' (the gang crew's own lounge song), gilt_vaults/iron_tunnels/iron_freight_yards -> 'underground' for both arcs, so the hideout theme plays in a mega area and the gang region songs stop feeling unique. regions.json music for gang regions is a stale fallback: hideout/docks 'rain', uptown/wastes 'boss', neon 'town', underground 'mine' (only AREA_MUSIC saves them; jungle's is 'cattopia'). If an AREA_MUSIC entry is dropped or a stream fails, uptown would play the generic boss song as its map music.
fix: Give mega areas their own songs or music_fallback to a non-arc track (mega_iron, mega_gilt) instead of hideout/neon; set regions.json music for docks/hideout/neon/uptown/underground/wastes to their own track names (in whatever writes regions.json) so AREA_MUSIC is not the only thing standing between them and 'boss'.

title: Meadow first boss (The President's Man) ends with a hard-coded play('meadow'), so a night or rainy win blips the day song for ~3 s
repro: meadow.gd _boss_down() (~line 199) calls Music.play('meadow'). DangerMusic.boss_ended then sees wanted()!='boss_gang' and leaves it; AREA_EVERY (3 s) later area_track() swaps to 'night' or 'rain'. The gang arc meets this boss early, when its rainy days are common.
fix: Use Music.instance(get_tree()).play(area_track(), DangerMusic.BOSS_WIND) (or just drop the line and let DangerMusic.boss_ended play the area song with its sting).

title: PREFETCH_GANG leaves out songs a gang player hits in the first days (shop_gang, battle_gang, uptown/underground are later, but shop_gang and the Outskirts song are early)
repro: music.gd PREFETCH_GANG = arc_gangsters, combat_light_gang, raid, countryside, boss_gang, hideout, neon, docks, combat_elite_gang. Only farm/house/title/title_musicbox are packed; on the web build the first visit to a town shop in the gang arc keeps the previous song until shop_gang downloads, then crossfades in mid-visit.
fix: Add shop_gang (and the new outskirts / night_gang tracks once rendered) near the front of PREFETCH_GANG; battle_gang/battle_siege_gang after the campaign unlock.

title: Gang-arc mega bosses (Rosa Thorne, Dune King Vasco, Big Ike Frost) play the penguin-world monster themes of their region
repro: gen_mega_new.py GANG_BOSS swaps gloam_moonpool -> garden_boss, desert_sunken_temple -> smuggler_king, frost_summit -> ice_hauler in the gang arc. boss_track finds no MEGA_BOSS stem, falls back to MEGA_REGION_BOSS: Rosa Thorne gets boss_thornmother, Vasco gets boss_colossus, Big Ike gets boss_wyrm (a rime-wyrm theme for a man on a sled). By design ('a reskinned boss still gets its region's theme') but they are human gangsters.
fix: Add the three gang kinds to boss_track: return 'boss_gang' for garden_boss/smuggler_king/ice_hauler (or a per-kind table), keeping region themes for the monster bosses.
needs_tom: Gang mega bosses: keep the region monster themes, or use the gang boss theme for the human rivals?

title: Frostpeak's Summit plays 'colony_ice' (the penguin arc's merkitty colony melody) in the gang arc too, where Big Ike Frost is the boss
repro: gen_mega_new.py line ~604: A('frost_summit', music='colony_ice', ...). Probe ARC=gangsters: frost_summit day/night -> colony_ice. That song is 'same melody' as the Coral Reach/Kelp Hollow colonies (penguin-only side arc, colony.gd refuses the gang arc), so a gang player hears a penguin colony theme at the top of the mega region.
fix: Give frost_summit its own song (e.g. music='mega_frost_summit', music_fallback='mega_frost') or simply 'mega_frost' until one exists; rerun gen_mega_new.py + gen_mega_regions.py.
audio_needed: Optional 'mega_frost_summit': windswept peak, low horns, ice-glass bells, wordless choir, 76 bpm.

title: Gang arc leans on a few songs: 'neon' in 3 places (Neon district, the Rec Hall, Gilt casino row), 'rain' for the Outskirts plus every rainy day, battle_gang on all 19 battlefields
repro: Probe ARC=gangsters (tools/probe_c6_02_gangmusic.gd): interior rec -> neon (gen_rec.py rooms gangsters music 'neon'), neon -> neon, gilt_casino_row -> neon; crystal_meadow -> rain, any wet day on NIGHT_OK maps -> rain; every bf_* -> battle_gang (siege/gate/defend/camp -> battle_siege_gang). Walking Rec Hall -> town -> neon district hears the same song twice.
fix: gen_rec.py: the gang Rec Hall can keep 'rec_center' (House Groove) or get a rec_gang track; neon stays the district's. Battlefields: optional per-field gang moods later (bf_neon_block/bf_uptown_plaza could reuse uptown/neon stems).
audio_needed: Optional rec_gang: lounge funk, organ, bowling-alley swagger, 104 bpm.
